title: Solution set for a universe-enlarged Hom functor
statement: Let C be an abelian category with Hom types in Type w, well-powered relative to w, and with coproducts indexed by Type max(w,vH). For any G in C, the explicit functor X |-> ULift Hom(G,X) to Type max(w,vH) modules over End(G)^op satisfies the solution-set condition with indexing sets in Type w. There is no separator condition on G, no derived category, and no adjoint is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 19.14.1, first proof, images of sums; agent-written quotient parametrization using Mathlib CategoryTheory.Abelian.subobjectIsoSubobjectOp

proof.text: For a module A, form P as the coproduct of copies of G indexed by the underlying set of A. Form the relation coproduct indexed by (A × A) ⊕ ((End G)^op × A), mapping its summands by i_(a+b) - i_a - i_b and i_(r•a) - r.unop ≫ i_a. Take the cokernel q:P → Q of this explicit relation map. Its defining relation makes a ↦ ULift.up (i_a ≫ q) a linear map f:A → ULift Hom(G,Q). Use the singleton PUnit in Type w as the solution-family index.

Given h:A → ULift Hom(G,X), the coproduct map k:P → X sends i_a to (h a).down. Additivity and scalar-linearity of h show that every relation is killed by k. The cokernel universal property therefore gives g:Q → X with q ≫ g = k. Coproduct and cokernel computation rules prove f followed by lifted Hom(g) equals h elementwise. This constructs all data using established coproduct and cokernel universal properties; no unproved theorem is used.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 19.14.1, second proof (presentations by generators and relations)
proof_origin.note: Second reader replaced the pointwise restatement with a complete explicit cokernel construction. Both coproduct indexing sets live in Type max(w,vH); the solution-family index is PUnit in Type w. WellPowered is retained in the unchanged signature but is not needed by this proof.
